retrieval_skill.name: layered_preorigin_driver_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve pre-origin evidence across future-driver, observation, and regime layers, including direct operational advisories, measurement-system changes, and competing baseline reports.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series around a known calendar or operational transition and the observed series may also be affected by instrumentation or logging changes.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for the exact monitored context and target metric together with the forecast window, then separately seek: authoritative notices about scheduled drivers, documentation of calibration or software changes, and independent reports describing the prevailing regime or offering a conflicting outlook.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when the source predates the forecast origin, applies directly to the monitored series or its causal driver, and clearly distinguishes real-world changes from measurement artifacts; retain contradictory evidence rather than silently resolving it, and require exact support for quoted language.
